changeSet.sql: INSERT INTO user_book_transaction (user_id, book_id, type, transaction_date, price, created_at, updated_at) SELECT user_id, book_id, 'SOLD', created_at::date, price, created_at, updated_at FROM user_sells_book WHERE UPPER(status) = 'SOLD';
